reuse_decision.new_owner: snapshotArtifacts(options SnapshotOptions, stdout io.Writer) error; one function with create/list/restore switch; types grouped with snapshot usage. ~150-220 straightforward lines plus ~15-25 fields/receipt lines, not a source-per-script adapter.
reuse_decision.considered: run owns argument dispatch, not manifest/copy transactions. patchCopy owns validated edits/recipes/registry; accepting empty or fake recipe would weaken source-preflight and couple snapshot metadata to patches. authorTexture owns bounded TXD/PNG, not large opaque binary snapshots. writeNewFile owns publication, so ENHANCE it for streaming; cannot reasonably own tags, receipts, listing or commit provenance.
reuse_decision.publication: Change existing writeNewFile(path, reader io.Reader, expectedSize int64, expectedSHA256 string, mode os.FileMode) error. Mandatory nonnegative size and full SHA; seek/readback only its own target. io.Copy(io.MultiWriter(target, hash), io.LimitReader(reader,size+1)); check size+digest before Sync; readback hash+size and existing SameFile check; close failure propagates; failure removes own inode only. No whole-file ReadAll. Existing2 production callers use bytes.NewReader and sha256.Sum256 on already-built bytes; existing public output behavior preserved. No new streaming helper or optional writer modes.
reuse_decision.cost: Create/restore apply each prehash the source, stream the verified copy and read back the destination: roughly3 payload passes, with bounded-memory IO.
reuse_decision.receipt_read: Use existing readInput for bounded regular receipt reads/size+mtime checks. Keep explicit nonsymlink preflight and strict one-value JSON validation in the lifecycle owner.

new_function: snapshotArtifacts: cohesive create/list/restore lifecycle; cannot reasonably belong to patch planning, image authoring, CLI routing or generic publication.
deliberate_limits: Restore to new explicit output only; duplicate tags refuse.
Receipt published last. Failed or interrupted create may leave an incomplete reserved tag for manual inspection; never delete unknown directories.
No old shared-manifest import, implicit current-ISO selection or registry checkout.
No atomic-filesystem-snapshot or hostile same-user directory mutation guarantee; reject observed symlink redirection and retain exclusive writes/readback.
verification: Focused existing CLI/publication owner plus build/vet/format/whitespace/selfchecked credentials. Full integrated/race suite deferred by user.
